findings.evidence: In `pkg/planner/core/stats.go:552-566`, `tiflashPath` is only set if a `kv.TiFlash` access path exists in `ds.AllPossibleAccessPaths`. When a heuristic `selected` path is chosen, `pkg/planner/core/stats.go:655-659` sets `keep := (PreferTiFlash || isMPPEnforced) && selected.StoreType != kv.TiFlash` and unconditionally appends `tiflashPath` (`append(ds.PossibleAccessPaths, tiflashPath)`) with no nil guard. But `pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:1243-1249` shows TiFlash paths are not added when `tblInfo.TiFlashReplica` is nil or not available (it only calls `RaiseWarningWhenMPPEnforced`). Downstream code assumes non-nil paths and dereferences without checks, e.g. `pkg/planner/core/stats.go:424-440` (`getGeneralAttributesFromPaths`) and `pkg/planner/core/indexmerge_path.go:74-105` (loops over `ds.PossibleAccessPaths` and reads fields like `CountAfterAccess`).
findings.fix: Gate the keep/append on `tiflashPath != nil` (e.g. `if keep && tiflashPath != nil { ... }`) so enforced-MPP on tables without TiFlash paths cannot insert a nil `*AccessPath`. Optionally keep the warning behavior (via `RaiseWarningWhenMPPEnforced`) but avoid mutating `PossibleAccessPaths` with nil.
findings.impact: With `tidb_allow_mpp=1` and `tidb_enforce_mpp=1` (or statement `set_var(tidb_enforce_mpp=on)`), queries on tables without TiFlash replicas (or replicas not ready) that hit heuristic pruning (common for point ranges / unique lookups) can produce `ds.PossibleAccessPaths` containing a nil entry and trigger a planner panic, causing query failures/outage.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master`: `derivePathStatsAndTryHeuristics` still appends `tiflashPath` without a nil guard (`upstream/master:pkg/planner/core/stats.go` around lines 594-703), and `getPossibleAccessPaths` still omits TiFlash paths when replicas are absent/not ready (`upstream/master:pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go` around lines 1275-1289).
findings.verify: Repro/verify by planning a point-range query on a table with no TiFlash replicas while `tidb_allow_mpp=1` and `tidb_enforce_mpp=1` (or statement-level `set_var(tidb_enforce_mpp=on)`), and confirm the optimizer no longer panics and produces a sane fallback plan with a warning (if applicable). Add a planner casetest covering enforced-MPP + no-TiFlash-replica + point-range access path pruning.
findings.what: `derivePathStatsAndTryHeuristics` can append a nil TiFlash access path when MPP is enforced but the table has no TiFlash access path, leading to planner panics when later code iterates `ds.PossibleAccessPaths`.

subject: planner: derivePathStatsAndTryHeuristics can keep more MPP task (#65264)
summary: Found a Blocker in planner path-pruning: under enforced MPP on tables without TiFlash replicas/paths, `derivePathStatsAndTryHeuristics` can append a nil TiFlash path into `PossibleAccessPaths`, which can later panic; this is not fixed in `upstream/master`.
